title: Mixing: Power To The People by John Lennon/Plastic Ono Band | 1971
content:
Studio Three, EMI Studios, Abbey Road
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Phil Spector

John Lennon/Plastic Ono Band’s single ‘Power To The People’ was mixed in stereo at Abbey Road Studios on 22 February 1971.

The song had been recorded at Lennon’s Tittenhurst Park home and Abbey Road, during two sessions that took place on 22 January.

The single’s b-side, ‘Open Your Box’, was mixed on the following day, and again on 4 March.
